audience: businesses that bill their clients with invoices and estimates in Billdu

useCases.title: Review invoices and their status
useCases.text: List the documents of one type, such as invoices, and open one to read its items, totals and status.

useCases.title: Look up a client before you write to them
useCases.text: List the clients and open one to read its contact details, address, tax ids and linked documents.

useCases.title: Create a client after a duplicate check
useCases.text: List the clients to check for a duplicate. Then create the new client from the fields that the user gave.

useCases.title: E-mail a document to a client
useCases.text: Open the document to check its items and total. E-mail it only after the user confirms the recipients and the message.

useCases.title: Check products and prices
useCases.text: List the products and services with their names, prices and tax rates. Open one to read its details.
